title: Spectral Dispersive Glass
description: A glass body whose interior optical path is solved in image space: the view ray refracts in, locates its exit against a back-face normal-and-distance buffer, keeps reflecting past the critical angle, and is traced once per wavelength for true Cauchy dispersion recombined through CIE 1931.
techniques: double-sided back-face data pass with inverted depth so the farthest surface wins
iterative image-space exit search along the refracted interior ray
exact unpolarised Fresnel with total internal reflection at every interface
per-wavelength Cauchy index from a catalogue (n_d, Abbe) pair
CIE 1931 piecewise-Gaussian spectral recombination into linear sRGB
Beer-Lambert absorption over the true internal path length
